entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 176 of 2021, under
Sections- 376-Ab, 120B, 323, 504, 506 Ipc and Section-3/4 of Pocso Act, police station Sarai
Khawaja, District Jaunpur, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the applicant, learned counsel for informant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
The alleged incident has been shown of 14.6.2020 but first information report was lodged by the informant after about one year on 2.6.2021.
The allegation that the applicant has committed rape upon the victim, is wholly false.

The victim has not sustained Raju Agrahari vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95055266/
1 any injury.

entities.text: Raju Agrahari vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per ossification test report, age of victim has been shown about 10-11 years.
Lastly it was stated that the applicant is languishing in jail since 3.1.2022, having no criminal history, and that in case he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

4. Learned A. G. A. as well as learned counsel for informant have opposed the application and submitted that as per prosecution version, while the victim has gone to attend a marriage function in her relation, the applicant has committed rape upon her.
The applicant is uncle of the victim.
Victim is stated about 10-11 years old.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
6. Accordingly, this bail application moved on behalf of the applicant Raju Agrahari is rejected.

7. However, considering the period of detention of the applicant, concerned trial court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same as early as possible, preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of certified copy of this order.

Order Date :- 14.3.2024 HR  Raju Agrahari vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95055266/
